CREATE VIEW BI_PackagingSpecs
--drop view BI_PackagingSpecs

AS

SELECT DISTINCT
    PC.ITNO AS [Item Number],
    PA.PACT AS [Packaging],
    PA.PANM AS [Packaging Name],
    PA.PACL AS [Packaging Length],
    PA.PACW AS [Packaging Width],
    PA.PACH AS [Packaging Height],
    PC.D1QT AS [Standard Qty],
    CASE LEFT(PA.PACT, 1)
        WHEN 'E' THEN 'Each'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Case'
        WHEN 'P' THEN 'Pallet'
    END AS [Package Type]
FROM M3.MITPAC PA
LEFT JOIN M3.MPACIT PC ON PA.PACT = PC.PACT
WHERE
    LEFT(PA.PACT, 1) IN ('E', 'C', 'P')
    AND PA.PACT NOT IN ('PALLET', 'P00000')
